text: Problem 1. Let V be a vector space over a field . Prove the following statements. (i) Let u,v € V be distinct vectors in V. Then u,v is linearly dependent if and only if u or v is a multiple of each other. (ii) Any subset of linearly independent vectors is linearly independent. (iii) Any set containing a set of linearly dependent vectors is linearly dependent. In particular, if a set of vectors contain a zero vector then it is linearly dependent.
